title: Unit Event — Step by Step! — Episode8 Unchanging Feelings

meta.Event Outline: Minori has told her groupmates in MORE MORE JUMP! that she wants to switch to the credit-based course. This hasn't been an easy decision to make, but she's been supported by some special people.

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe...
I can't believe how much fun we had, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me neither. I really wasn't expecting them to throw us such a wonderful surprise party.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I made the decision to make the most of each day, but this very first one ended up becoming totally unforgettable!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even after we go credit-based, we can look back and...
<Minori! Haruka!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
That voice...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Evening, you two.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What brings you all here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<So, the thing is...
We spent the entire day seeing what your school life is like, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! You did?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You all care deeply about making the most of your life as high school students, so we wanted to see what that's actually like.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Especially since I wished that I could help Airi more when she asked us for advice the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<We apologize for not telling you.
We just really wanted a good insight into what you're like as students.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, that's totally fine!
Actually, your timing couldn't have been better!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I did a ton of things today as a part of making the most of the time I have left as a regular student!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but... I got a problem wrong after raising my hand during class... I hope you guys didn't see that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. Yes, we saw that as well.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You seem to really enjoy your school life, and it was so dazzling to see... So much so that I wish I could also be a student!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But you won't be able to do the kind of things you did today so much after you go credit-based, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes...
I'm beginning to see why this was such a tough decision...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Still, I think you made the right choice...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I've been wanting to see what your friends are like since you've been telling us so much about them. And how much they mean to you.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <After finally getting to see them for ourselves today, Minori, Haruka...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It's clear that they all feel the same way about the both of you.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, I think you'll be okay. You all care deeply about each other, and those feelings will keep you together.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<And it's like what KAITO said.
The bonds you've forged won't break that easily.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You'll all be friends regardless of where life takes you.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We all had a ton of fun together today, and they even gave us these really thoughtful gifts.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so glad that I became friends with them, and I really believe now that we're gonna be friends forever.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, I agree... I think we made the right decision.
It was only for one short year, but... I had so much fun during my time as a regular high schooler.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And that's why these memories will help me move forward. Towards our dream...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna work as hard as I can so more and more and mooore people start following MORE MORE JUMP! And someday...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wanna be able to spread hope to all of the friends who supported me along the way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, that was a little embarrassing to say out loud...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<No, Minori...
I believe you can do it.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I agree. I mean, Minori, you know just how important it is for an idol to walk this journey with their fans.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<And it's not just you...
Haruka, Airi, Shizuku...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Each member of MORE MORE JUMP! has worked tirelessly to establish connections with all of your fans.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Which is much more difficult than you may realize, because both parties need to feel the same way about one another.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <In that sense, it's like the bonds you've forged with your friends...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You should be able to keep making real connections with any number of people moving forward.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And spread hope to them.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <With you and Haruka switching to the credit-based course, your group as a whole will be able to do considerably more as idols...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You'll get to work more, and all sorts of people will see what you're doing. In and of itself, that should be fun... But you'll also likely be faced with more challenges along the way.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Those are the times when I hope you'll be reminded of what you feel is most important.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What we feel is most important...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, I know what she's talking about!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<You just said it, Minori.
How you wanna spread hope to everyone!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, that does seem to be the motto of MORE MORE JUMP! at this point. The compass that always guides you girls...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Precisely. And you've all gotten this far because of that feeling in your hearts.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <So, as long as you don't forget that, I think you'll all do just fine.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I firmly believe that.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She's right...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (My lifestyle's gonna change pretty drastically, and I'll start realizing things that I never would've before...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It probably won't always be smooth sailing, and things might feel really hard at times.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you all so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I also believe we'll be able to handle whatever's thrown at us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um... O-Of course, I know things won't always go smoothly, and I'm a little afraid of having to deal with tough problems...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But like MEIKO said...
I have the desire in my heart to spread hope.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And we all have each other.
That's what makes us MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We've had to deal with lots and lots of things until now... But we overcame all of those obstacles together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That includes you guys, Miku.
You were all there every step of the way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Us too...?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
It's a little embarrassing for me to say, but this felt like the right time...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for always being there for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That includes wanting to know what we're like as students. I really appreciate how kind and thoughtful you all are...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's right. You and the others are always happy to listen to our concerns and give us advice, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't thank you enough for giving us that kind of support...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Exactly!
There's no way we would've been able to come this far without you guys.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In that sense...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys are just as much a part of MORE MORE JUMP! as we are!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, uh oh...
Was I out of line?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Not at all...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yes, we couldn't be happier!
We promise to cherish what you just said.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know that you and the others are always rooting for us and have our best interests in mind, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No matter what happens, I'm gonna keep trying my best...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wanna make the most of the support you guys give us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So that we can keep spreading hope to more and more and more people!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah...!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We're really looking forward to that!>

rows.Speaker: Movie
